item.title: Version 1.5.43
item.description:
🎉 v1.5.43 Update

  • 🔧 Menu Bar Support Link
    - The “Support on Ko-fi” menu item now remains available for Free users and is hidden for Pro license holders.
  • 💄 License Tab Updates
    - Updated Free Tier and Pro Features descriptions to clarify Ko-fi menu behavior.
  • ✨ OpenAI OAuth Model Updates
    - Added GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5 pro to the ChatGPT OAuth model list.
    - Added non-streaming handling for GPT-5.5 pro responses.
